tools.name: getInfo
tools.description: Returns the complete profile of Jorge Arraga, an Argentinian AI-focused software engineer who is actively available for freelance projects. Includes his full work history, current role at Staffy, technical skills, ongoing English study, location, contact details, and links in English, Spanish, or Portuguese.

locale.description: Language for the returned information: en for English, es for Spanish, or pt for Brazilian Portuguese.

tools.name: send_contact_message
tools.description: Sends a contact message directly to Jorge Arraga by email. Use this when the user wants to contact Jorge about a project, role, collaboration, or professional question. The supplied reply email becomes the email Reply-To address. The message is delivered immediately, so confirm the subject, message, and reply email with the user before calling this tool.

subject.description: A concise email subject describing why the user is contacting Jorge.

message.description: The complete message to deliver to Jorge.

replyEmail.description: The sender's email address. Jorge can reply directly to this address from the delivered email.
